description: Start a paid job billed to the user's Desearch balance: find people on X, YouTube, LinkedIn, or TikTok who match a plain-language description. Each person comes back with a fit score, why they matched, their audience, and public contacts and links. This call reserves count times the platform's per-person price (reserved_cost_usd) and returns a task_id at once. When the search ends you pay only for the people it delivered (a per-search minimum applies when it finds anyone; a search that finds no one is free) and the rest of the reservation is returned. The search runs in the background, usually for 1 to 5 minutes: poll people-search-status with the task_id to read progress and the people found so far, and use people-search-control to pause, resume, or cancel it. Do not start the same search twice; send idempotency_key so a retry returns the first task instead of charging again. Filters depend on the platform. x: min_followers, max_followers, verified_only, countries, keywords, exclude_keywords. youtube: min_subscribers, max_subscribers, countries, require_contact, keywords, exclude_keywords. linkedin: min_followers, max_followers, countries, keywords, exclude_keywords. tiktok: min_followers, max_followers, require_contact, keywords, exclude_keywords.

count.description: How many qualified people to find (5-200, API default 25). The search reserves this many and bills only the people it delivers.

countries.description: Countries to prefer, example: ['US', 'GB']. x, youtube, linkedin.

exclude.description: Handles to leave out, for example people you already contacted.

exclude_keywords.description: Leave out people who mention these words. All platforms.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string for this search, for example a UUID. Sending the same key again returns the first task and is not charged again.

keywords.description: Words that should appear in their posts, videos, or bio. All platforms.

max_followers.description: Maximum follower count. x, linkedin, tiktok.

metadata.description: Your own labels for this search, example: {"campaign": "q4-outbound"}. Up to 10 keys; keys are 1-40 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_', '.', '-'; values are strings of up to 200 characters. Returned on the task; filter people-search-tasks by it. The search does not use it.

min_followers.description: Minimum follower count. x, linkedin, tiktok.

min_score.description: Only return people with at least this fit score (0-100).

platform.description: Where to look: 'x' (X profiles), 'youtube' (YouTube creators), 'linkedin' (LinkedIn members), or 'tiktok' (TikTok creators).

query.description: Who you are looking for, in plain language, example: 'Skincare creators who review sunscreen'.

require_contact.description: Only creators with a public email (tiktok: in the bio; youtube: an email or contact link). youtube, tiktok.

verified_only.description: Only verified or X Premium accounts. x only.

name: people-search
title: People Search
